content.text: Excellent! The fix is working. Let me clean up the test subscriptions and commit the changes:

input.command:
git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fix floating-point precision error when converting prices to cents

When multiplying decimal prices by 100 (to convert to cents), JavaScript's
floating-point arithmetic produced values like 3995.0000000000005 instead
of exactly 3995, causing the validation to reject valid prices like 39.95.

Using Math.round() ensures the result is always a whole number, fixing
prices across all entry points: parseEuros, cellCents, and
decimalCommaToCents.
EOF
)" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
